description: Multi-Grid solver from the NAS Parallel Benchmarks. Performs V-cycle multigrid with Jacobi smoothing, restriction, and prolongation on a synthetic 3D grid. Grid size is rounded up to the nearest power of 2. Emits per-pass kernel times; throughput is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: grid_size
scaling_param.description: Grid dimension N for the NxNxN 3D mesh; must be a power of 2 (8-512). Values are the distinct problems the solver actually runs (the code rounds any N up to the next power of 2, so intermediate values would be silent duplicates).

non_scaling_params.name: num_smooth_steps
non_scaling_params.description: Number of Jacobi smoothing steps per level per direction

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
